name: Vision of Triumph
body:
School divination; Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, fateshaper 1, inquisitor 1, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action
Components V

EFFECT

Rangeclose (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target 1 creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Crying out a single stirring word grants your ally sudden strength and resilience. When you cast this spell the targeted creature gains a bonus to its next saving throw or skill check equal to your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (whichever is highest) made before the end of the current round.
